archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with SaaS Noir

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-black uppercase
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-bold uppercase

layouts.hero: Asymmetric layout with strong left-aligned typography. Text should sit on top of a dark overlay (bg-black/60 to bg-black/80 gradient) blending into a cinematic hero background image. Use 'The Swiss Grid' principles. Do not center-align the hero text.
layouts.features_bento: MODE A: 'Tetris' Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Mix tall (col-span-4 row-span-2), square (col-span-4 row-span-1), and wide (col-span-8 row-span-1) blocks. 1px technical border.
layouts.spacing: Use p-8 to p-12 for bento containers. Use py-24 to py-32 for section vertical rhythm.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism for Sticky Header (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Use Grid Borders for Feature Cards (flat dark background #0F0F12, 1px border-white/10, hover:border-yellow-500/50).
visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion for staggered entrance animations. Consider a 'Tracing Beam' effect for high-tier Pricing Cards.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Sharp edges or extremely minimal rounding (rounded-sm). Primary button must be Electric Yellow (bg-yellow-400) with solid black text. Hover state should lift (-translate-y-1) with a yellow drop shadow.

motion.stagger_children: Use Framer Motion to stagger bento grid items by 0.1s.
motion.hover_states: Hovering bento items should slightly brighten the border (border-white/20) and subtly scale an inner element/icon.
motion.scroll: Elements should gently fade in and translate-y-4 into place as they enter the viewport.

components_to_use.custom_instructions: Strip the Vercel-look from Shadcn components. Override default radius to rounded-none or rounded-sm. Override default borders to border-white/10.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure yellow text/buttons have dark text inside them (black). Do not use dark text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='pricing-card-pro').

images.description: High-rise construction site, use with heavy bg-black/70 overlay to ensure text readability.
Abstract neon grid pattern, use for the 'Company Brain (AI)' and 'Future AI Automation' bento block background.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for duotone/bold industrial feeling icons. Install with: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react. lucide-react is also acceptable.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
NEVER use AI emojis (🤖🧠💭). Use proper SVG icons.
NEVER apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8 to p-16) for a premium feel.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
Rely heavily on subtle border colors (border-white/10) to define dark mode sections, not massive background shifts.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns.
